visible_grader.quote: Column0 equation (1): P + 2H + K = R + 10*c0. We have R = P + 1 (since c3 =1). So equation becomes P + 2H + K = (P + 1) + 10*c0 => cancel P both sides: 2H + K = 1 + 10*c0.
